label: Formulated and introduced The Absurd & Sisyphus's Revolt
description: Albert Camus formulated and introduced the concept of "The Absurd & Sisyphus's Revolt", which became a seminal contribution in ethics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in ethics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Albert Camus's canonical writings.
